architecture: FAST AGGRESSIVE BASE + 5 CONDITION-SPECIFIC SURGICAL OVERRIDES

overrides.trigger_condition: opp_active_max_hp >= 160 AND opp_has_lethal_counter == True AND bench_has_1shot_ko == True
overrides.intended_failure_mode: Prevents suicidal chip damage into lethal retaliating tanks
overrides.source_evidence: V1 losses (8 losses in Window C/D)

overrides.intended_failure_mode: Prevents over-stacking energy on doomed or fully-loaded active
overrides.source_evidence: V1/V3 telemetry and energy dissipation replays

overrides.trigger_condition: opp_prizes_left <= 2 AND active_hp >= 140 AND active_energy >= 2 AND bench_ready_attackers >= 1
overrides.replacement_action: Veto benching -> Select next highest aggressive action (ATTACK / ATTACH)
overrides.intended_failure_mode: Prevents offering 2-prize bench-gust KO targets in 2-prize endgame
overrides.source_evidence: V3 live failure cluster (13 of 23 live losses)

overrides.trigger_condition: opp_archetype == Alakazam AND active_energy >= 2 AND bench_count > 0
overrides.intended_failure_mode: Caps active energy at 2 to minimize Alakazam Psychic damage scaling (10 + 30/energy)
overrides.source_evidence: V4/V5 live replay mining (Alakazam spread matchup)

overrides.intended_failure_mode: Avoids 0-damage turns against Cornerstone Mask ex / ex-immunity walls

default_fallback: select_base_aggressive_action (100% preserves original aggressive tactical priority)
